description: GCP-GridFEDv2019.1 provides monthly fossil carbon dioxide emissions and associated oxygen uptake on a global 0.1-degree grid from 1959 to 2018. The Zenodo record lists a release archive, and the Scientific Data descriptor identifies source layers for coal, oil, gas, cement and bunker fuels with uncertainty estimates. Energy-transition or industrial-emissions simulations can use these grids as historical priors or compare spatial allocations. They are inventory-consistent estimates, not direct measurements at each grid cell. Bunker fuel emissions should not be added to national totals in the same way as domestic source classes, and grid-cell uncertainties are not independent when aggregating. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. I read own metadata and article descriptions without downloading the 36-GB archive or running inversion models. A related v2020.1 release extends the period to 2019 and is reviewed separately. The prior candidate was rejected for sector routing, not because the data lacked reuse value.
